headline: Every can checked before it is palletised.
label: #F4EAD5
heroLede: More designs in shorter runs means more changeovers where the wrong print can slip through. Here's what a camera check could look like near the end of your can lines. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every can for dents, creases and damaged flanges that can be seen from outside. A damaged flange is the fault your customer finds when the can will not seam on their filler.
labelLede: A limited edition and the core range design can look much the same at line speed. The camera checks every can carries the right print for the order, straight, clean and complete.
codeLede: The line code ties every can back to its line and shift. The system reads the code on every can and compares it with the order set at changeover.
objectLede: Can scrap, spoilage and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the line spots anything that should not be there before cans are palletised.

vocab.c1h: No dents, creases or damaged flanges
vocab.alert: Four damaged flanges in fifteen minutes. Check the flanger.
